run_train_main: run the main training loop for VJEA2 video model with distributed data parallel
build_init_video_model: build the VJEA2 video model encoder and predictor with configurable architecture parameters
build_init_opt: build optimizer and learning rate scheduler with weight decay and warmup schedules
build_init_data: build distributed data loaders with mask collator for video and image datasets
build_mask_collator: build mask collator for multi-sequence multi-block 3D masking strategy
